description: This file implements the persistent database aging operation for the prplMesh project, periodically checking and clearing aged client data based on configurable time delays.

classes.name: persistent_database_aging_operation
classes.description: A class that performs periodic aging checks on persistent client data in the database.

methods.name: persistent_database_aging_operation
methods.description: Constructor initializing the aging operation with a time interval, database reference, and operation name.

methods.name: periodic_operation_function
